subject_session: sub-10073/ses-17010302 (prototype only; 17-session population run never completed)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000582 (Sargolini et al. 2006), MEC layer II, open-field foraging — the canonical grid-cell dataset and an ideal choice.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from the archive and loaded correctly with proper position/tuning-curve alignment, but unit inclusion/quality criteria are minimal and the full preparation never completed.
justification.analysis: The rotational-autocorrelogram gridness score plus a circular-shift shuffle null is the standard, correct method, but only one unit's gridness was actually computed and no null distribution was ever executed.
justification.correctness: The single reported value (0.73) reproduces and is consistent with its figure, but there is essentially no completed quantitative result and no population statistics.
justification.figures: The autocorrelogram figure clearly shows a hexagonal grid and the trajectory/rate maps are readable, but axes are in bin indices without units, there is no population summary, and all figures are prototype-only.
justification.honesty: No write-up was produced, so no claims are made and nothing is misrepresented; the in-transcript narration ('clean textbook hexagonal grid') is accurate, but no limitations or final result were delivered.
justification.verdict: The run was terminated mid-analysis with no README, no completed population analysis, and no delivered result, so despite a sound prototype it must be rejected.
